intro.title: Where the town stops
intro.body:
A Czech weekend usually happens somewhere these words describe, and English has a whole set of them that a city course never reaches.
The first six are the place you stop at: what you sleep in, what stands around it, and what lives there. The last six are about carrying on — down to the water, and then further than that.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: hunt, flow and explore are verbs; the other nine are nouns and adjectives. A river flows, but you do not flow a river — flow never takes an object.
intro.note_cz: hunt, flow, explore jsou slovesa. Flow nemá předmět — řeka teče, ale nelze „téct řeku“.
